shared_elements: use of a T-shaped or pillar-like stone form
justification: Both are large carved stone monoliths with some low-relief surface treatment, but A shows figurative animal reliefs (birds, quadrupeds) arranged in horizontal registers while B shows an abstract, rounded anthropomorphic form with minimal linear markings. The biggest difference is the subject matter and carving depth—A is narrative/figurative relief on a flat pillar, B is a fully three-dimensional sculpted human-like figure with only faint incised bands.
